modifications: Restrict output to canonical HTTPS artwork and anime URLs; omit author, account, preview-video and image-CDN fields.
Parse IQDB confidence within each result table and reject missing, negative, ambiguous or out-of-range scores.
Require finite trusted confidence: at least 0.87 for trace.moe and 0.60 for SauceNAO/IQDB.
Validate response envelopes and no-match formats and bound titles to 160 characters.
Run a local headless Chrome/Chromium as a singleton with an explicit profile, optional proxy, secure DNS and idle shutdown instead of a Windows-only Edge path.
Accept only the fixed Google start/upload pages; no caller-supplied URL, proxy or executable reaches the upload flow.
Return bounded HTTPS Lens candidates; account extraction and reply formatting are delegated to the unchanged upstream functions in accounts.mjs.
Map captcha, unreachable Google, missing browser and deadline failures to stable codes without echoing upstream text.
Bound the whole search, each CDP call and the number of resolved result cards.
Ported verbatim from the upstream file; only module imports and exports were adapted.

No new platforms, name rules or reply layout were added: Twitter/Weibo/Bilibili/Instagram/Pixiv URL rules, reserved-path filtering, strict dominant-name consensus and the original reply text are unchanged.
No face recognition and no handle guessing; accounts exist only when a result URL backs them.

newCode.description: Independent fixed-endpoint multipart client with image signature validation, bounded streaming responses, upload redirect refusal, cancellation, per-engine deadlines and isolated failures. Lens is a fourth isolated engine with its own deadline.
